editor.label: Server Config:
editor.description: A .cfg file in bms/cfg to execute when the server starts (letters, digits, ".", "-" and "_").

editor.label: Max FPS:
editor.description: Adjusts the frames per second that the server will process.

editor.label: Startup map
editor.description: The map the server starts on. The map cycle continues from mapcycle.txt.

editor.label: Team deathmatch
editor.description: Players fight in two teams (HECU marines and scientists) instead of free for all.

editor.label: Friendly fire (team deathmatch)
editor.description: Team mates can hurt each other.

editor.label: Map time limit (minutes)
editor.description: Minutes before the server changes to the next map of the map cycle (0 = no limit).

editor.label: Frag limit
editor.description: Kills that end the map (0 = no limit).

editor.label: Hostname
editor.description: Up to 64 characters. Not allowed: double quotes, backslashes, semicolons, line breaks.

editor.label: RCON Password
editor.description: Up to 32 characters. Not allowed: double quotes, backslashes, semicolons, line breaks.

editor.label: Private Password
editor.description: Up to 32 characters. Not allowed: double quotes, backslashes, semicolons, line breaks.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the server browser. No double quotes.

editor.label: Join password
editor.description: Leave empty for a public server. No double quotes.

editor.label: RCON password
editor.description: Needed for the panel RCON and for rcon_password logins. No double quotes.

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Writes steam_appid.txt and keeps the previous console log. Makes srcds executable and installs missing 32-bit libraries (apt, dnf or yum).

script.name: Add the Workshop item
script.description: Adds the Workshop item to the server (bms/subscribed_file_ids.txt) and its maps to the map cycle. The server downloads and updates it when it starts; players get it from the Workshop.

script.name: Remove the Workshop item
script.description: Removes the Workshop item from bms/subscribed_file_ids.txt and its maps from the map cycle, and deletes its files.

script.name: Unpack Workshop items
script.description: Unpacks the .vpk packages of the Workshop items in bms/subscribed_file_ids.txt that are new or were updated: the server mounts an item folder, not the packages in it.
